properties.name: A claim a result supports reads supported given the model held on purpose, not merely conditional
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-28, gap 2 of the design-a-phenomenon skill (#807)
properties.statement: A claim whose prediction a recorded result matches, and which rests otherwise only on premises held on purpose (held_as model or principle), reads supported given those held premises, naming each, instead of plain conditional. A claim that still rests on an undischarged supposition, or on evidence no pinned source documents, reads as it does today. It never reads proven. Designs that use no held_as read exactly as before.
